Synopsis:
Putin warns Ukraine of retaliatory strikes on its "most sensitive economic sectors" following Kyiv's drone campaign against Russian economic infrastructure. Russia is actively targeting Ukrainian grain export routes via the Black Sea. Putin dismisses global food shortage concerns, claiming Russia can offset Ukrainian export losses, while reaffirming openness to peace talks only on Russia's terms.
